change: Replace FIFO backlog selection with deterministic critical-path-first dispatch across all currently ready Goal DAG steps.

algorithm.score: Weighted longest root-to-sink path containing each task. TaskGraph estimated_effort is host-validated; non-TaskGraph Goal steps default to effort 1, and all weights are capped at 1000000 before scheduling.
algorithm.tie_break: Stable input order, preserving existing plan order among equal scores.
algorithm.selection: Seed currently ready nodes once; when a step succeeds or is host-skipped, inspect only its direct successors and enqueue those whose full dependency set is satisfied. A binary heap selects by criticality and stable plan order.
algorithm.complexity_per_selection: O(V+E) graph and score build once per dispatch wave; O(out-degree * readiness-check + log V) per completion/skip event; O(log V) heap pop per worker slot.
